scenes.title: Ashvale Ki Aakhri Normal Shaam
narration: *Greenreach ki pahadiyon mein chhupa Ashvale — chhota sa gaon, garam khet, aur ek aisi shaam jaise waqt ne aaram kar liya ho.*
*Tum {{playerName}} ho. Isi mitti mein paida hue, isi hawa mein bade hue. Tumhari poori duniya yahi hai — khet, maa-baap, aur teen ladkiyan jo tumhare saath guthliyaan phodti hui badi hui hain.*
*Nadi ke kinare wala purana oak. Wahi jahan dus saal pehle, chhote haath jod kar, chaaron ne wada kiya tha — bade hokar ek dusre se shaadi karenge.*
Lyra: "Suno suno — jo is saal pehla amrod girega, wahi sabse pehle shaadi karega. Rule hai rule, argue mat."
Seris: "Ye kaisa rule hai? Main books se wada karungi, tum amrod se. Aaj hi research karke bataungi ki fruits se shaadi decide hona kitna unscientific hai."
Valeria: "Jo bhi karega, pehle mujse talwar paar karega. Simple."
*Hasi phootti hai — wahi purani, aadat ki hasi. Par aaj tum sabke chehron mein kuch aur bhi hai... jaise sab kuch badalne wala ho.*
*Kal se tum sab 18 ke ho jaoge. Aur is duniya mein, kaha jaata hai, 18vin saal sapne sach kar deta hai.*
fallbackLines: *Gaon ki mandir ki ghanti bajti hai — shaam dhire-dhire andheri ho rahi hai. Kahin door koi baaansuri baj rahi hai.*
Valeria: "Kahan kho gaye ho? Kal subah saare discuss karenge — aaj sirf hum chaar hain. Bhaagna mat."
*Hawa mein kuch alag hai aaj — halki si charge, jaise intezaar kar rahi ho.*

choices.text: Purane oak ke neeche jaakar bachpan ka wada yaad karo

memory: Bachpan mein {{playerName}}, Lyra, Seris aur Valeria ne purane oak ke neeche ek dusre se shaadi ka wada kiya tha.

choices.text: Ghar wapas jaao — maa ki daal aur baap ki fikar intezaar kar rahi hai

memory: {{playerName}} apne maa-baap Doran aur Elena ke bahut kareeb hai — uski family uski duniya hai.

choices.text: Kheton ke peeche chhup ke apni chhoti si aag ka practice karo

memory: {{playerName}} ki apni ek chhoti si fire magic hai — hawaidaar, par abhi kachchi; woh use chhup ke practice karta hai.

scenes.title: Wahi Sapna
narration: *Us raat, chaaron ko — tumhe, Lyra ko, Seris ko, Valeria ko — EK HI SAPNA aaya.*
*Andhera, aur phir roshni — jaise kisi ne aasmaan mein suraj ko thoda sa tez kar diya ho. Ek shakhs roshni se hi bana hua hai.*
Seren: "Suno, chune gaye log. Main hoon Seren — roshni waali. Tum chaaron ne bulaya nahi, phir bhi chune gaye ho."
Seren: "Andhera badh raha hai. Malgareth ke takht par baitha Vorgath — jise log Demon King kehte hain — use harana hai. Aur ye kaam kisi akele ka nahi... ye PRINCE KA hai."
Seren: "Aldric. Mera chuna hua Hero. Tum chaaron uske saath jaoge — uski party, uski hifazat, uska saath. Wahi tumhara dharm hai."
*Roshni mein ek pal ke liye uski nazar chaaron par ghoomti hai — aur tumhe lagta hai, sirf lagta hai, ki tum par ek second zyada ruki thi.*
Seren: "Raasta kathin hoga. Aur jo tum haraoge, woh sirf dushman nahi hoga. Yaad rakhna."
*Subah aankh khulti hai to chaaron ek hi cheez bol rahe hote hain — tumne bhi wahi dekha.*
Lyra: "Ruko... tum sabko bhi wahi devi dikhi? Laal-gold roshni? Achha to main pagal nahi hoon. Wait — YE KAISA MAMLA HAI?"
fallbackLines: *Sapna aankhon mein abhi bhi chamak raha hai — jaise roshni dheere-dheere jaa rahi ho.*
Seris: "Same dream, same words, same devi. Probability zero hota hai normal cases mein... to case normal nahi hai."
Valeria: "Capital jaana padega. Prince se milna padega. Pack karo — aur koi drama nahi."

choices.text: "Par devi ne hamein kyun chuna? Hum sirf gaon ke bachche hain"

memory: 18vin saal mein {{playerName}}, Lyra, Seris aur Valeria ko ek hi raat ek hi sapna aaya — devi Seren ne chaaron ko Prince Aldric (destined Hero) ka saath dene ke liye chuna.

choices.text: Turant doston ke paas bhaago — sab se confirm karo ki sabko same sapna aaya

memory: Sapne waali subah chaaron ne ek dusre ko dhoondha — pehli baar unka bachpan unke kaam aane wala tha.
Devi Seren ne chaaron bachchon ko Prince Aldric, the destined Hero, ke saath jaane ke liye chuna.

choices.text: Chup-chaap saaman pack karna shuru karo — jisko jaana hai, use taiyaari chahiye

memory: Devi ke sapne ke baad {{playerName}} ne bina shor machaye saaman pack karna shuru kar diya — kaam pehle, emotions baad mein.

scenes.title: Velmora — Chamakti Capital
narration: *Pahadiyon ke paar se pehli nazar mein Velmora aisa lagta hai jaise kisi ne suraj ko zameen par rakh ke usse sheher bana diya ho — sunehri spires, safed raste, bade bade bazaar.*
*Chaar gaon ke bachche gate ke paas khade hain, muh khula. Guards bina sawaal hata rahe hain — aaj sab Hero ke mehmaan hain.*
Lyra: "Ye... ye itna BADA kaise hai? Mera gaon iske EK MINAR mein khoya jayega. Zara measure mat karna, mera dil dukhega."
Seris: "Dekho — tax board. Market toll: zero. Trade levy: zero. Ye... ye impossible hai. Itni badi kingdom, zero taxes? Kis kismat se chal rahi hai ye?"
Valeria: "Poochna mana hai to mat poocho. Log kehte hain Seren ki kripa hai. Chal, aage."
*Bazaaron mein log muskura rahe hain — asli, sukoon waali muskurahat. Itna aish, itni safalta... aur kahin koi tension nahi.*
Seris: "Kripa... shayad. Par mujhe batao — jab koi cheez FREE dikhti hai, to uski asli keemat kahin to jaa rahi hogi na?"
fallbackLines: *Sheher ki khushboo meethi hai — roti, phool, aur thodi si dhuiein. Har mod par kuch naya hai.*
Lyra: "Suno, ye raste hi sona jaise lagte hain. Ya mujhe aankh ka problem hai? Seris, check karo."
*Do guards aise guzre jaise koi Hero aa raha ho. Poora sheher kisi ka intezaar kar raha hai.*

choices.text: Ek budhe trader se poocho — itne kam taxes kaise? Koi wajah to hogi

memory: Velmora mein taxes lagbhag zero hain — Seris ne notice kiya, trader ne kaha 'devi ki kripa hai'. Asli wajah kisi ne nahi batayi.

choices.text: Doston ke saath sheher ghumo — ye din phir nahi aayega

memory: Velmora pahunch kar chaaron ne pehli baar ek saath bada sheher dekha — aakhri baar jab sab sach mein saath the.

choices.text: Seedha Temple of First Light jaao — jahan milna hai wahin hai

memory: Velmora pahunchte hi chaaron Temple of First Light ki taraf badhe — devi ke bulawe par.

scenes.title: Aashirwad Aur Aukaat
narration: *Temple of First Light — safed paththar, aur wo lamba hall jahan subah ki pehli kiran seedha altar tak aati hai. Wahin prince khada hai.*
*Pehli baar ALDRIC ko dekh kar samajh aata hai ki bheed itni pagal kyun hai. Wo muskurata hai aur poori room uski lag jaati hai.*
Aldric: "To ye hain wo chaar jo devi ne chuna. Swagat hai. Kal se hum sab ek team hain — aur main wada karta hoon, history yaad rakhegi hum sabke naam."
*Phir aashirwad ki rasam. Roshni chaaron par utarti hai — aur har ek ke andar kuch jag jaata hai.*

*Lyra ke haath mein arcane nishaana wala teer chamakta hai — arcane archer ki taqat. Seris ke aankhon ke saamne equations khud ba khud likhe jaate hain — mage ka aether. Valeria ki talwar aur kandhe ek hi heartbeat mein jud jaate hain — magic knight.*
*Aur tum... tumhare haath mein ek chhoti si laal aag jagti hai. Tip si. Cute si. Peechhe koi awaaz aati hai — izzat wali par halki.*
Priest: "Aur ye... Fire. Basic-grade. Aur ek doosri cheez dikhti hai — dimensional storage? Rare hai, beta. Safai ka kaam aayega."
Aldric: "Dimensional storage? To party ka khazana humesha saath rahega! Dekho, iska matlab hum bahut halka travel karenge. Shabash, dost. Tum bahut... useful ho."
*Safed roshni mein sab hanste hain — acchi awaaz mein, buri nahi. Par kaam ki baat wahi ho gayi thi: useful.*
fallbackLines: *Aag tumhari hatheli par tip-tip nachti hai — chhoti, par tumhari apni hai.*
Lyra: "Mera teer dekha? YAAR mera TEER! Sorry sorry — tumhara bhi achha hai. Sach mein. Thoda aur... practice karo."
*Andar kahin ek awaaz keh rahi hai: koi tumse poochh nahi raha ki tum kya ho. Sab poochh rahe hain ki tum KAISE kaam aoge.*

choices.text: Storage ka demo do — apna poora saaman andar dhal do, phir wapas nikaal kar dikhao

memory: {{playerName}} ko do abilities mili — chhoti/basic fire magic aur dimensional storage (koi capacity limit nahi; sirf wahi cheez andar ja sakti hai jo woh khud utha sake). Party ne storage ko 'utility' samjha.

choices.text: Apni aag par focus karo — chhoti hai, par tumhari hai; ise bada karoge

memory: {{playerName}} ki fire magic basic-grade hai — chhoti si aag. Usne mann mein faisla kiya ki ise badhana hai, chahe koi na poochhe.

choices.text: Raat ko maa-baap ko letter likho aur apni khaas chhoti cheezein dimension mein sambhal lo

memory: {{playerName}} ne maa-baap ko letter likha aur apni niji cheezein — Seris ke banaye purane fire-notes samet — dimension mein sambhal li.

scenes.title: Mission Par — Walking Pocket
narration: *Mahine guzar gaye. Hero party poore Eldrane mein ghoomti rahi — monster ke ghaatiyon se lekar ruins tak.*
*Aur har mission par ek pattern ban gaya. Supplies? {{playerName}} ke dimension mein. Equipment? Dimension mein. Monster loot, tents, khana, medicine — sab dimension mein.*
Lyra: "{{playerName}}! Ye ghoul ke daant bhi andar daal do — bas jaldi, humein aage badhna hai. Achha ladka ho tum, sach mein."
*Aur dheere-dheere... aage badhna sirf Aldric ke aage badhna ban gaya. Training sirf uske saath. Baatein sirf usse. Hansi sirf us par.*
Seris: "Aldric, wo spell ek baar phir dikhao? Main note kar rahi hoon. {{playerName}}, tum... tum wahan baithe ho? Theek ho? Good."
*Ek raid mein tumhara kandha katta hai. Wraith-hound ka panja guzar gaya — dard gehra tha, khoon beh raha tha.*
*Healing aati hai... Aakhri mein. Pehle Aldric ka chhota sa kharoach — 'Hero ko pehle', bol kar. Phir Lyra ka thakaan. Phir Seris ne bina dekhe spell daala, aadha-adhura.*
Valeria: "Zinda ho? Chalo. Kal aur missions hain. Saaman sambhal lena."
*Tumhara kaam ab bas ek hi hai: utha lo, andar daal do, chup raho. Party ka walking pocket.*
fallbackLines: *Kandha abhi bhi dukh raha hai. Kisi ne poocha hi nahi.*
Aldric: "Pocket! Ye loot bhi le lo. Waah, jitna utha le utna — kaash sab itne aaram se useful hote."
*Raat ke camp mein teen hasi ki awaazein ek taraf se aati hain. Tumhari taraf se sirf aag ki tip ka crackle.*

choices.text: Kisi ek dost se sach mein baat karo — pata hai wo sunengi nahi, phir bhi try karo

memory: Missions ke dauraan teeno ladkiyan dheere-dheere Aldric ki taraf khisak gayi — {{playerName}} ki value sirf dimensional storage reh gayi; zakhmi hone par bhi healing late aayi.

choices.text: Chup raho. Kaam karo. uthao, andar daalo, aage badho

memory: {{playerName}} ne mahino tak chup-chaap party ka saaman uthaya — bahar khamoshi, andar ek dheemi jalti hui cheez.

choices.text: Aldric ke kareeb rehne ki koshish karo — shayad wahi jagah hai jahan sab hain

memory: {{playerName}} ne Aldric ke kareeb rehne ki koshish ki — Hero sabke liye jagah rakhta tha, bas ek hi phone chhodkar.

scenes.title: Tum Door Raho
narration: *Ek shaam, ek akele camp. Teen ladkiyan saath aati hain — pehli baar mahino mein, khud. Tumhe lagta hi nahi tha ki ye din aayega.*
Lyra: "Hum... {{playerName}}, hum baat karni thi. Seedhi baat. Bahut seedhi."
Seris: "Aage ki journey mein tum humse door raho. Training alag, camp alag, routes alag. Ye... ye sabke liye better hai."
Valeria: "Aldric ke saath rehna hai humein. Uske saath hum... kuch bada kar sakte hain. Tum samajh gaye na?"
*Samajh gaye. Bilkul samajh gaye. Wahi purana oak, wahi chaar bachche, wahi wada — sab andar ek second mein ghoom gaya.*
Lyra: "Wo wada... arey, wo bachpan ki baat thi. Bachpan ka. Hum badal gaye, {{playerName}}. Tum nahi badle, wahi ka problem hai."
Seris: "Koi drama nahi chahiye. Bas... distance. Theek hai? Theek hai."
*Teeno palat kar chali jaati hain. Neeche ret hai, upar taare waise hi hain. Sirf tumhari duniya ka hissa gayab hai.*
fallbackLines: *Aur kuch keh nahi rahe ho. Bolkya jaaye, jahan teeno ne ek hi awaaz mein faisla kar liya ho.*
Valeria: "...Jao. Aur aage se aisa mat dekho. Please."
*Aag ki tip kaat rahi ki awaaz aati hai — tumhari apni aag, jaise tumhe hi jala rahi ho.*

choices.text: "Wajah batao. Ek wajah. Sirf ek"

memory: Teen doston ne khud {{playerName}} ke paas aa kar keh diya — ab humse door raho. Wada bhool gaye, party chhod di.

choices.text: Chup-chaap teeno ki aankhon mein dekho — ek bhi pal ke liye

memory: Rejection ki shaam {{playerName}} ne teeno ki aankhon mein dekha — Lyra ki aankhein jhuk gayi thin, Seris ki nahi, Valeria ki aankhon mein aag thi.

choices.text: "Chalo jao. Waise bhi wada sirf bachpan ke liye tha na?"

memory: Rejection ke waqt {{playerName}} ne kadwa jawab diya — wada sirf bachpan ka tha to theek hai. Andar kuch toota, bahar sirf ek jumla.

scenes.title: Malgareth Ka Aakhri Daar
narration: *Blighted Wastes ka kaala ilaaka — aur uske beech MALGARETH. Obsidian ka fortress, itna bada ki uske saaye mein poora gaon sama jaaye.*
*Aaj hero party ka aakhri mission hai: Demon King ke kill tak seedha attack. Bheed ne kaha tha — aaj history banegi.*
*Darwaze todte hi shaitani sena tootti padti hai. Chaos, aag, aur teen chamakti ladkiyaan jo aage badh chuki hain — Lyra ke arcane teer hawa mein phool jaise khilte hain.*
*Aur phir... throne hall. VORGATH khada hai — itna bada ki deewarein uski parchhai sameti lagti hain. Ek hi jhatak mein aadha hall gir gaya.*
*Aldric aage badhta hai. Do aur roshni ki lehrein — aur phir ek second ke liye sab kuch galat ho jaata hai.*
*Vorgath ka panja Aldric ko maar leta hai — wo hawa mein udta hai, paththar se takraata hai... aur chala jaana chahiye tha.*
*Par uske chehre ke saamne SONA roshni ubharti hai — devi ki hifazat. Ek aaina jaisa shield jo poore hall mein roshni phaila deta hai.*
Aldric: "...Achha try kiya. Ab meri baari."
*Ek hi strike. DAWNBREAK. Roshni ka ek itna bada lahar ki deewarein, takht, aadha pahada — sab ek line mein mit gaya. Jab dhool bai-thi, Vorgath gira hua tha. Demon King khatam.*
*Sab jashn mein doob jaate hain — aur usi dhool mein ek toot-ti deewar tumhe andhere ke us paar dhakelti hai. Akele.*
fallbackLines: *Kaale paththar ki deewarein habsi lagrahi hain. Peeche jashn ki goonj aati hai — aage sirf sannata.*
*Kandhe par purana zakhm phir dukhne laga hai. Aaj tak kisi ne dressing nahi badli.*
*Hawa mein ek ajeeb khushboo hai — jasmine aur raakh. Jaise koi yahan hai... dekh raha hai.*

choices.text: Wapas mud kar party ki awaaz dhoondo — kahin peechhe hi honge

memory: Malgareth ke assault mein Aldric lagbhag maar aaya — devi ki golden hifazat ne use bachaya — phir ek hi Dawnbreak strike se Vorgath gira. Sab maane Demon King khatam.

choices.text: Andhere ke us paar badho — kuch... bulaa raha hai

memory: Malgareth girne ke baad {{playerName}} akele andhere ke us paar chala gaya — kuch usse bulaa raha tha. Ye uski kahani ka sabse bada mod banne wala tha.

choices.text: Gire hue hall ka saaman sambhalo — party ka hisaab tumhara kaam hai

memory: Aakhri bhi ladai ke baad sabse pehla kaam {{playerName}} ko hi mila — loot sambhalo. Aadat bhi thi aur kaam bhi.

scenes.title: Laal Aankhein
narration: *Toote hue hall ke us paar ek aur kamra hai — chhota, shaant, aur bilkul nahi toota. Yahan tak Dawnbreak ki lehar nahi aa payi.*
*Beech mein ek obsidian ka takht hai. Aur us par... ek aurat baithi hai.*
*Kale kapde, kale baal, aur aankhein — LAAL. Itni laal ki andhere mein bhi chamakti hain. Woh tumhe dekh rahi hai, bilkul shant, bilkul seedha.*
Lilith: "Ek... do... teen... chaar. Waah. Itne saare jeetne waale, aur yahan ek akela haara hua ladka ghoom raha hai. Kahani mein balance hai, pasand aaya."

Lilith: "Suno, akele aane waale. Main hoon LILITH. Aur tumhare Hero ne jo aaj giraya — wo Vorgath tha. Ek bheedu. Ek naqaab. Asli raaja... raani... main hoon. Ab bolo — kaisa lag raha hai apni duniya ka sabse bada jhooth jaan ke?"
*Awaaz mein nafrat nahi hai. Khel hai. Aur uske peeche... kuch aur bhi — jaise woh tumhare andar ka toota hua hissa DEKH rahi ho.*

Lilith: "Divine gaze poori duniya cheet rahi hai — devi ki nazar se sirf ek hi jagah bachi hai. Ek insaan ki pocket. Tumhari pocket, jaan. Mujhe andar rakh lo. Warna... yahin khatam ho jaoge, aur main bhi. Dono ka nuksaan. Bura sauda hai."

*Ek kadam peeche. Phir ek aur. Tumhara jee nahi chahta — par uski laal aankhon mein ek haqeeqat chamak rahi hai: woh sach bol rahi hai. Aur tum itne toote hue ho ki ladne ki himmat nahi bachi... phir bhi ek aur kadam.*
Lilith: "Achha, aisa karo. Ye mat socho ki tum mujhe bacha rahe ho. Socho — tum ek DEV QUEEN apni jeb mein le ja rahe ho. Kaun asli toota hua hai?"

*Tum use uthaate ho — halki hai, jaise koi panchhi ho. Puri duniya mein akeli cheez jo aaj tumhare bharose ke layak hai. Andhera dhalta hai... aur Lilith, asli Demon Queen, tumhare dimension ke andar chhup jaati hai.*
fallbackLines: Lilith: "Hadar mat karo, main intezaar kar rahi hoon. Andar poori arrangement hai — koi baat nahi."
*Laal aankhein andhere mein bhi nahi jaati — jaise do chhote suraj ho jinhone raat se sauda kar liya ho.*
*Yahi akela kamra hai jahan tumhara dard koi trophy nahi lag raha. Yahan koi dekh nahi raha. Aur yahi sabse ajeeb lag raha hai.*

choices.text: "Tum... asli Demon Queen ho? To ye sab — jung, Hero, sab kya tha?"

memory: Lilith ne khud bataya — Vorgath asli ruler nahi tha; LILITH asli Demon Queen hai. Ye raaz ab sirf {{playerName}} ke paas hai.
Lilith ab {{playerName}} ke dimensional space ke andar chhupi hai — divine gaze wahan nahi pahunchti. Ye dono ka shared secret hai.

choices.text: "Nahi. Main kisi demon ko apne andar nahi rakhunga" — phir uski nazar ne jawab de diya

memory: {{playerName}} ne pehle Lilith ko mana kiya tha — usne dhamki di, aur toota hua ladka haar kar bhi jeet gaya: usne asli Demon Queen ko apne dimension mein sambhal liya. Raaz ban gaya.

choices.text: "Theek hai — par iska matlab tum ab meri responsibility ho. Mere rules"

memory: {{playerName}} ne Lilith ko apne rules par andar liya — meri responsibility, mere rules. Lilith pehli baar hansi thi... achhi awaaz mein.
Lilith asli Demon Queen {{playerName}} ke dimension mein chhupi hai — sirf dono ko pata hai.

scenes.title: Jashn Aur Tanhaai
narration: *Agla din. Velmora aisa nahi hai jaisa kal tha — aaj poora sheher sadko par hai. Phool, dhol, har chhat par jhanda.*
*DEMON KING KHATAM. Sunspire palace ke samne ek bada stage — aur us par ALDRIC, chamakte hue, poori duniya ka aadha hissa apni jeb mein.*
Aldric: "Logon! Aaj sirf ek Hi-ki jeet nahi hai — aaj NAYI SUBAH hai. Main, tumhare agle Raja ke roop mein, wada karta hoon..."
Aldric: "...aur har naye daur ki shuruaat apne logon se hoti hai. Aaj main teen aurton ko apna jeevan-saathi chunta hoon — Lyra. Seris. Valeria. Teen engagement, aaj, sabke saamne, pakki."
*Bheed pagal ho jaati hai. Teen ladkiyan stage par chadhti hain — Lyra ke kandhe par naya kamaal, Seris ke sar par naya taj, Valeria ki talwar salami de rahi hai.*
*Phir inaam. gold, titles, jagirein — chaar heroes ke naam, ek-ek karke announce hote hain. Teen ladkiyon ke naam... aur ALDRIC ka naam.*
*Paanch log the party mein. Chaaron heroes ko inaam milta hai... aur ek ka naam aaj tak kisi ne nahi liya.*
*Tum bheed mein khade ho — sabse peeche, sabse neeche. Aur musibat ye hai ki aaj tumhe jalne ki bhi himmat nahi hai... bas ek ajeeb si khaali-pan.*
Aldric: "...aur ek aur naam. Hamaara apna chhupa hua khazana — {{playerName}}! Aaiye, jagah banao. Sab dekh rahe hain."
fallbackLines: *Taaliyan goonj rahi hain. Tumhari taraf se sirf ek aadmi palat kar dekhta hai — ek budha trader jisne tax wala sawal suna tha.*
*Hawa mein phool ki khushboo hai. Kisi ne tumhare kandhe par phool phenka hai — shayad galti se.*
Aldric: "Kahan ho, {{playerName}}? Sab tumhara intezaar kar rahe hain. Public hai, jaan. Sab kuch dekh rahe hain."

choices.text: Aage badho — shayad... inaam? Maafi? Kuch to hoga

memory: Jashn ke din Aldric ne agla Raja hona aur teen engagements (Lyra, Seris, Valeria) announce kiye; chaaron heroes ko bade inaam mile — {{playerName}} ko kuch nahi mila.

choices.text: Bhaagne ki soch — ye bheed, ye shor... sab kuch backing

memory: Jashn mein {{playerName}} bheed se bahar nikalne ki soch raha tha — par Aldric ne usi waqt uska naam liya. Poora sheher palat kar dekha.

choices.text: Bhaav se badho — jo hona hai, hone do

memory: Jashn ke din {{playerName}} ka chehra bhaav hi nahi tha — na gussa, na dukh. Khaali. Aur yahi khaali-pan uski sabse badi taqat banne wali thi.

scenes.title: Jhoothi Ilzamaat
narration: *Aldric ka haath uth'ta hai. Bheed chup ho jaati hai. Tum aage badhte ho — aur poora sheher tumhe dekh raha hai.*
Aldric: "{{playerName}}. Mere saathi. Mera dost. Aur... jaise har kahani mein hota hai — ek dushman bhi."

Aldric: "Mahino se hamara loot gayab ho raha tha. Sabne socha shayad monsters ka koi syndicate hai. Par aaj hisaab kitab hui. Saara saaman... EK HI JEB MEIN MILA. Us jeb ka naam tumhare paas hai, dost."
*Tumhara dil ruk jaata hai. Dimensional storage. Wohi jo tumhara apna tha — ab crime ka proof bana diya gaya hai.*

choices.text: Oak ke neeche baith jao — maa-baap aur bachpan ko alvida bolo

memory: Ashvale ke purane oak ke neeche {{playerName}} ne maa-baap aur apna bachpan alvida kaha. Usi jagah jahan chaaron ne wada kiya tha — ab wahan se badle ka wada shuru hua.

scenes.title: Nightwilds
narration: *Jahan kingdom ki Map khatam hoti hai, wahin se Nightwilds shuru hote hain — wo ilaaka jahan raat kabhi poori nahi hoti.*
*Kaale ped, neele phool, aur wo raaste jo khud badal jaate hain. Insaan yahan mehmaan hai — sirf tab tak jab tak koi demon use zinda rakhna chahe.*

Lilith: "Ah... ghar. Is khushboo ko saalon baad... Bhool mat jaana jaan — main tumhare andar hoon, tum meri aankhein ho. Jo tum dekhoge, main dekhungi. Chalo... mera court ab bhi kahin jagah hua hoga."
*Yahan uske purane log hain — bikhre hue, chhupe hue, takht ke intezaar mein. Kuch usse nafrat karte honge — purane rivals, bikhri hui wafayein. Sab apni izzat se ladte hain.*
*Aur yahan ek sach bhi sota hai: Vorgath ke peeche kaun tha, devi ka plan kya tha... demon court ke purane records mein.*
fallbackLines: *Kaale pedon ke beech se ek jodi aankhein tumhe dekh rahi hain... aur hata nahi rahi.*
Lilith: "Yahan dosti ka matlab alag hai, jaan. Yahan wafa wo hai jo raat bhar chalti hai. Phir bhi... mere kuch log... unse milna chahiye."
*Hawa mein purani raakh aur naye iraade.*

choices.text: Purane records dhoondo — Vorgath ke peeche ka sach yahin kahin hai

memory: Nightwilds mein {{playerName}} ne demon court ke purane records dhoondhna shuru kiya — Vorgath, devi aur Lilith ke takht ke sach ki taraf pehla kadam.

choices.text: Lilith ke purane logon se milo — the True Court ab bhi zinda hai

memory: Nightwilds mein {{playerName}} ne Lilith ke purane loyalists — the True Court — ke nishaan dhoondhna shuru kiye. Kuch ab bhi uske naam par intezaar mein the.

choices.text: Lilith se uska apna raaz poochho — takht chhodne ka wo faisla kya tha

memory: Nightwilds mein {{playerName}} ne Lilith se uske apne past ke baare mein poochhna shuru kiya — sadiyon pehle takht chhodne ka wo faisla.

scenes.title: Aage Ka Raasta
narration: *Raaste par ek mod aata hai jahan sab kuch wapas sawaal banta hai — kya kar rahe ho, kiske liye, aur kis kadam ke baad.*

Lilith: "To? Aage kya? Main to yahin hoon — tumhari jeb mein, poori raat ke saath. Par jeena azaadi ka matlab sirf saans lena nahi hota, jaan. Ab har din tumhara design hai. Aur har din ek cheez marta hai — ya dushman, ya tumhara purana aadmi."
*Naye din, naye naam, naye raaste. Kingdom bada hai — aur tumhare paas ab wo hai jo kisi ke paas nahi: waqt, raaz aur aag.*
*Kahin door Velmora mein ek Raja apne naye singhasan par baitha hai... teen ranis ke saath. Aur usse nahi pata ki uski sabse chhoti entry — wo pocket — ab azaad hai.*
fallbackLines: *Raasta wahin hai jahan tum use chhodo. Bas ek baat yaad rakho — har mod par wahi purana oak yaad kar lena.*
Lilith: "Faisla tumhara, consequences sabke. Maza yahi hai na?"
*Aag ki tip ab hawa mein naachti hai — aaram se, azaadi se. Jaise kabhi kisi ne usse 'cute' na kaha ho.*

choices.text: Velmora ke pardon ke peeche — sach, sources aur suraakh
Ironmark — taqat, kaam aur naya naam
Ashvale — jo bacha hai use sambhalna hai, aur jo chhupa hai use dhoondhna
Nightwilds — Lilith ka court, uska sach, uske log
